title: Clause node inputs
statement: For a natural number $m$ and a DNF term $C$ on $m$ coordinates, the clause node inputs are those indices in a set of size $m2^{2m}$ whose associated block index and sign assignment match the index and required sign of at least one literal of $C$; the match requires equality of the block index with the literal’s coordinate and equality of the parity inner product of the assignment with the literal’s required sign.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the informal definitions of the sign encoding, parity inner product, or assignment-index equivalence.
